body:
**[Original report](https://bitbucket.org/agriggio/art/issues/330) by Leopoldo Saggin (Bitbucket: [Leopoldo Saggin](https://bitbucket.org/Leopoldo Saggin), ).**

----------------------------------------

Hi all.  
I’m lurking on [Pixels.us](http://Pixels.us) ART forum and - after a bad experience with darktable - I’m trying to adopt ART as my raw/jpg images processing software. I’m studying the video lessons in French, but as I know \(not too much, indeed!\) only English, I need to have a translation so I’m going slowly in the process of understanding ART also because I have no experience with RawTherapee.  
Anyway, I installed the latest ART version, ie 1.23 for Windows and until today I did not try to save/export the result of processing images.  
Unfortunately the first time i tried to save/export a .jpg image \(starting from another .jpg, not raw! image\) ART crashed.  
I cannot say what was exacty happened, but:  
a\) at first I modified an image \(few things: exposure, rotation and crop\)   
b\) I put that image into the queue to export it but when I activated the export the program told me that it was unable to save the modified file.  
c\) So I discovered that “Windows security” against ransomware set a “protected access” to directories for ART and prevented it from saving modified images.  
d\) As soon as I understood this and while ART was still running while the queue job was paused, I modified this option in Windows to allow ART to save images.  
e\) So I went back to ART and I “cancel” job queue \(which contained one image\). At this point ART disappeared abruptly.  
f\) I tried to restart it but wasn’t able. In fact using Task Manager I saw that the ART process was still active. So I killed it manually.  
g\) Even in these conditions I was not able to restart ART. So I decided to reboot the PC in order to be able to open ART again.

Herein enclosed you find the crash dump file that was created. No idea if it could be useful to understand what happened.  
  
In any case thanks to Alberto for his program: I think it will be my favourite one for processing images. I think I’ll oin to the forum as soon as possible!  
Topoldo/Leopoldo
title: ART 1.23 Win11 Pro crash
